title: $53,000 Into $48 Million With a Dying Stock #shorts
description:
In January twenty twenty-one, Keith Gill, known online as Roaring Kitty, turned a bet on GameStop worth about fifty-three thousand dollars into roughly forty-eight million dollars on paper.
Follow for more fortunes made and lost.
first_comment: Would you have sold at one million, or held for forty-eight like he did? 👇

lines.text: He turned fifty-three thousand dollars into forty-eight million.
With a stock everyone said was dying.
In twenty nineteen, Keith Gill bet on GameStop, a struggling video game store.
Big Wall Street funds were betting it would fail.
He posted his trades online, under the name Roaring Kitty.
Millions of small investors started buying too.
In January twenty twenty-one, the stock exploded, up more than twenty times in weeks.
His account hit about forty-eight million dollars.
Fifty-three thousand dollars, turned into forty-eight million, with a dying stock.
Follow for more fortunes made and lost.
